entity.name: Musungu Peter
entity.description: Founder and lead developer of Sovra, an experimental open-source general-purpose programming language and developer toolchain for human and AI-assisted software engineering.

projects.name: Sovra
projects.description: Sovra is an experimental open-source general-purpose programming language and developer toolchain implemented primarily in Rust. The project explores predictable semantics, structured diagnostics, integrated developer tooling, and machine-readable compiler information for human and AI-assisted software development.

channels.description: Bank transfer to the individual project owner's account. Banking instructions will be provided privately to approved funders.

plans.name: Sovra Development Fund
plans.description: Funding will support core compiler and language engineering, package infrastructure, developer tooling, testing, documentation, and research into AI-assisted software development.
